ali.automation: Build a Daily Huddle Report Generator that automatically collects the required data, calculates the metrics, and formats the report into a standard template.
ali.recommendation: Good candidate once we know where the huddle data comes from. Start with an uploaded/exported report, then automate the data pull.

ali.automation: Create an RM Activity Tracker that monitors activity/status and highlights changes, missing activity, or items needing attention.
ali.integration: CRM / activity tracking system integration required
ali.recommendation: Useful for removing repetitive manual checking. Exact difficulty depends on where RM activity is stored and whether an API is available.

ali.automation: Build a Task Reassignment Assistant that checks contacts/tasks against predefined rules and recommends or applies the correct RM assignment.
ali.recommendation: The rules need to be clearly defined first. Start with AI recommendations + human approval before allowing automatic reassignment.

ali.automation: Create a ProspectBoss Report Generator that pulls activity data and automatically summarizes performance into a standard report. To Tara
ali.recommendation: Straightforward if ProspectBoss provides usable access/API. Otherwise, start with exported data.

ali.automation: Build a Registration → PB List Cleaner that compares registered attendees against calling lists and identifies people who should be removed.
ali.recommendation: Very good automation opportunity because the logic is mostly data matching and filtering.

ali.automation: Build an Email Campaign Prep Assistant that creates the audience, checks exclusions, prepares content, and runs a pre-send QA checklist.
ali.integration: CRM + email marketing platform integration required
ali.recommendation: AI can handle the content and QA easily, while audience/exclusion logic requires system access. Keep final sending human-approved.

ali.automation: Create an Inbox Monitoring Assistant that categorizes incoming emails, summarizes conversations, extracts action items, and highlights only messages that require attention.
ali.recommendation: Strong use case for AI, but automatic monitoring needs Gmail access and clear rules for priority/action detection.

ali.automation: Build a Client Outreach Tracker that identifies who needs follow-up, determines the next follow-up date, tracks response status, and prepares the appropriate message or call note.
ali.recommendation: This becomes a full workflow rather than just AI generation because it needs to maintain contact state over time.

ali.automation: Build an Event List Preparation tool that combines lead sources, standardizes fields, cleans bad data, deduplicates contacts, splits lists based on rules, and creates upload-ready files.
ali.recommendation: Excellent automation target because there are many repetitive data-cleaning steps. Needs strict rules to avoid deleting or changing valid records incorrectly.

ali.automation: Build an Event Stats Automation that collects registrations, attendance, opt-ins, tags, Big Event sign-ups, and other metrics and updates the event report automatically.
ali.recommendation: High-value automation, but it depends on how many separate systems hold the event data and whether they can be accessed automatically.

amrissa.request: Recruiting and candidate screening — send interview invites
amrissa.automation: Create an Interview Invite Assistant inside the AI Task Hub. User provides the applicant information and AI prepares the appropriate interview invitation based on the position and available details.
amrissa.integration: No app required for drafting. Recruiting CRM + Email/Calendar integration required for automatic sending and scheduling.
amrissa.recommendation: Start with AI-generated invites and human approval. Once her CRM and email workflow are confirmed, automate the sending and status updates.

amrissa.automation: Build a Candidate Communication Assistant with options such as Interview Invite, Follow-Up, Rejection, Bench Notification, Onboarding Reminder, and Custom Message.
amrissa.integration: No app required for initial version. CRM + Email integration required for automatic delivery.
amrissa.recommendation: One of the best early AI Task Hub tools because multiple recruiting messages can be handled through one system.

amrissa.automation: Build a Contractor Follow-Up Manager that tracks maintenance requests and identifies pending quotes, appointments, invoices, licenses, insurance, and unfinished work. AI can prepare the appropriate follow-up message.
amrissa.integration: App / CRM / Property Management System required for automatic tracking. Email integration required for automated communication.
amrissa.recommendation: Start by generating follow-up messages from manually entered information. Full automation should come after we identify where maintenance records are stored.

amrissa.automation: Create a Property Maintenance Summary Assistant that turns long emails/messages into: Issue → What Has Been Done → What Is Still Needed → Next Action.
amrissa.integration: No app required for manual copy/paste or upload. Email / Property Management System integration required for automatic collection.
amrissa.recommendation: Strong AI use case. Start with manual input, then connect the actual communication/property system.

amrissa.automation: Build a Contractor Quote Comparison tool where quotes are uploaded and AI extracts price, equipment/materials, labor, warranty, inclusions, exclusions, and missing information into one standardized comparison.
amrissa.integration: Document/file upload required. Optional spreadsheet/database integration for saving comparisons.
amrissa.recommendation: Very useful because it converts several documents into one consistent comparison. Human review should remain before selecting a contractor.

amrissa.request: Research properties and create property summaries
amrissa.automation: Build a Property Research Assistant that collects listing information and outputs a standardized property table with price, square footage, year built, bedrooms, bathrooms, property type, and other criteria.
amrissa.integration: Web research / property listing access required.
amrissa.recommendation: The AI summary itself is easy; reliable automated property research is the harder part because the system needs access to listing sources and consistent data.

amrissa.request: Create and organize trackers and spreadsheets
amrissa.automation: Build an AI Spreadsheet Assistant that cleans data, identifies missing information, sorts/organizes records, creates formulas, and generates reports based on a defined spreadsheet structure.
amrissa.recommendation: Good automation candidate, especially if she repeatedly uses the same trackers. First identify her current spreadsheets and their structure.

amrissa.request: Turn emails and messages into action items
amrissa.automation: Create an Email-to-Tasks Assistant that extracts Person → Task → Deadline → Priority → Follow-Up Date → Status from emails/messages.
amrissa.integration: Email / Messaging integration required for automatic reading. Task management/CRM integration required for automatic task creation.
amrissa.recommendation: Start by allowing her to paste an email/thread into the Task Hub. Later, connect Gmail or the actual communication platform.

amrissa.automation: Build an SOP Generator that turns an existing process description, notes, or recorded workflow into a standardized SOP, checklist, and training guide.
amrissa.integration: No app required for initial version. Document/knowledge base integration optional later.
amrissa.recommendation: Very easy to implement and also valuable for documenting the systems we build for Club Wealth.

amrissa.automation: Create a Daily Admin Assistant that organizes tasks, prioritizes urgent items, identifies follow-ups, and gives Amrissa a daily summary of what needs attention.
amrissa.integration: No app required for manual task input. Calendar + CRM + Task System integration required for a fully automated version.
amrissa.recommendation: Build the standalone planner first. Connect her actual task/calendar/CRM systems after the process form identifies the sources.

jaymar.automation: Build a New Client Post Generator that takes the client's basic information and creates Facebook Page and Group captions ready for review and publishing.
jaymar.integration: IFS integration required for automatic client information retrieval. Social media integration optional.
jaymar.recommendation: Start with manual client information input so the AI tool can be built quickly. Connect IFS afterward.

jaymar.automation: Create a Birthday Content Assistant that pulls upcoming birthdays, generates personalized captions, creates graphic directions/copy, and organizes them into a posting schedule.
jaymar.integration: IFS + Google Sheets/Calendar + design tool integration required
jaymar.recommendation: Good candidate for recurring automation. The biggest benefit comes from automatically pulling birthdays and generating the scheduled content.

jaymar.automation: Build a Lead Source Tracker that identifies where new members came from, updates the Lead Sources List, and prepares appropriate follow-up messages.
jaymar.integration: IFS/CRM integration + Facebook/social data access required
jaymar.recommendation: The AI part is manageable, but automatically identifying lead sources and monitoring new member posts requires multiple data sources and potentially Meta access.

jaymar.automation: Create a Social Content Generator that takes videos, transcripts, quotes, testimonials, or topics and produces platform-specific posts for Facebook, Instagram, Threads, and Groups.
jaymar.integration: No app required for initial version. Cloud storage/social integrations optional.
jaymar.recommendation: One of the strongest quick wins. AI can handle the repurposing directly from the Task Hub.

jaymar.automation: Build a Threads Content Generator where one topic/hook becomes a complete Threads-style post plus 5–10 supporting comments.
jaymar.recommendation: Very easy to implement and requires almost no external integration.

jaymar.automation: Create a Marketing Creative Assistant that turns a marketing request into graphic concepts, copy, layouts, dimensions, and platform-specific variations.
jaymar.integration: No app required for concepts/copy. Canva or design-tool integration optional.
jaymar.recommendation: Excellent early Task Hub feature. Actual graphic production can be added later.

jaymar.automation: Build an Event Publishing Generator that takes one event brief and creates Facebook Page/Group posts, Google Business content, promotional captions, and reminders.
jaymar.integration: No app required for content. Google Business/social media integrations required for automated publishing.
jaymar.recommendation: Very good opportunity to use a single event brief to generate everything needed for promotion.

jaymar.automation: Build a Referral Opportunity Finder that identifies relevant Facebook Group posts, organizes opportunities by location, identifies the appropriate Club Wealth member, and prepares SMS outreach.
jaymar.recommendation: Monitoring and qualifying posts across Facebook Groups makes this significantly more complex than simple content generation.

jaymar.automation: Create a Marketing Calendar Assistant that organizes events, birthdays, testimonials, promotions, and recurring posts into a weekly calendar and daily task list.
jaymar.integration: Google Sheets/Calendar or task-management integration required
jaymar.recommendation: Start with AI-generated calendars, then connect the actual calendar/task system for automatic scheduling and updates.

jaymar.automation: Build a Content Repurposing Engine where one video, transcript, testimonial, event, or training topic generates captions, posts, hooks, graphic copy, CTAs, and promotional content.
jaymar.integration: No app required initially. File/video/transcript integration optional.
jaymar.recommendation: This should be one of the first tools built because it can support several other Jay requests at once.

camille.automation: Create an Event Planning Assistant that takes the event details and generates the room capacity plan, hotel function agenda, 3 theme options, VIP dinner concepts, raffle logistics, and transportation estimates.
camille.integration: No app required for planning. Event/CRM + spreadsheet + hotel/vendor data integrations for live execution.
camille.recommendation: Start with AI-generated planning packages. Keep vendor decisions and approvals with Camille.

camille.automation: Create an Event Communications Generator that takes one approved event brief and generates registration emails, SMS, landing-page copy, speaker/sponsor outreach, attendee logistics, and post-event coaching follow-up.
camille.integration: No app required for content generation. Email/SMS/CRM/GHL integration required for automated delivery.
camille.recommendation: Great Task Hub feature. One event brief should be the single source used to create all communication assets.

camille.automation: Build a Campaign Generator that creates registration, confirmation, reminder, live-now, post-event, replay, and coaching-offer messages and automatically adapts them for clients, past attendees, no-shows, and new prospects.
camille.integration: CRM/email/SMS platform integration required for segmentation and scheduling.
camille.recommendation: Build the content-generation engine first; automate segmentation and delivery afterward.

camille.automation: Create a Webinar Setup & Performance Assistant that prepares required Zoom/Keap assets and then analyzes registrations, show-ups, and conversions against previous events.
camille.recommendation: Very useful because it combines preparation and post-event analysis, but live system data is needed.

camille.automation: Build a Recruiting Assistant that generates job posts, evaluates applications against predefined criteria, ranks candidates, and prepares interview questions and scorecards.
camille.recommendation: High-value automation, but candidate screening should be based on documented criteria and remain human-reviewed.

camille.automation: Create an Onboarding Automation that prepares agreements, expectations, training checklists, welcome messages, and collects/adds payroll, Time Doctor, and Wise details for new hires.
camille.integration: Recruiting/HR + Payroll + Time Doctor + Wise integrations required
camille.recommendation: Several systems and sensitive employee data are involved. Build in stages and require human approval before onboarding/payroll actions.

camille.automation: Build a Payroll Preparation System that imports the Time Doctor exports, matches employees to Wise emails, separates CW/PFL/HX batches and paydays, and produces upload-ready files.
camille.integration: Time Doctor + Wise + payroll spreadsheet/database integration required
camille.recommendation: This is one of the highest-risk requests because it's financially sensitive and depends on exact matching, calculations, and batch rules. Human review should remain mandatory.

camille.automation: Create a Payroll Validation Assistant that checks missing roster entries, unusual hours/amounts, manual payments, and answers pay questions using the exact Time Doctor formula.
camille.integration: Time Doctor + payroll data integration required
camille.recommendation: AI can help identify exceptions and explain the formula, but calculations and outputs need strict validation.

camille.automation: Create a Meta Ads Assistant that uses approved Half Day/recognition templates to generate copy variants, Canva-ready graphic specifications, audience/budget setup, launch checklists, and campaign performance diagnostics.
camille.integration: Meta Ads + Canva + campaign data integration required
camille.recommendation: Start with AI-generated assets and launch checklists. Automate campaign setup and performance analysis later.

camille.automation: Build a Content Production Pipeline where a source such as a blog draft, success story, or lead magnet is processed into branded HTML, fact-checked posts, PDFs, email, and SMS promotion.
camille.integration: No app required for initial generation. CMS + Canva/document + email/SMS integrations for full automation.
camille.recommendation: Strong candidate for the AI Task Hub because one source can produce multiple finished assets.

omerson.request: Automate AWS server and infrastructure monitoring and connect it with Slack
omerson.automation: Build an Infrastructure Monitoring & Alert System that monitors AWS services and sends Slack/email alerts when defined alarms or infrastructure events occur.
omerson.integration: AWS + Slack integration required; AWS monitoring/alerting services and webhook/API
omerson.recommendation: This is a good automation target, but I would start with read-only monitoring and alerts. Avoid giving AI permission to change infrastructure until the monitoring is proven reliable.

omerson.request: Work the security backlog down / automated scheduled security audits
omerson.automation: Build a Security Audit Assistant that runs scheduled checks, collects findings, categorizes vulnerabilities/misconfigurations, and creates a prioritized security report.
omerson.integration: Security tooling + AWS/Club Wealth/University access required
omerson.recommendation: Start with audit/reporting only. Automated security edits should come much later because an incorrect change could create a security incident or take down a system.

omerson.automation: Build a Deployment Verification System that checks staging/production after deployment and verifies that the expected code/change is actually live and functioning.
omerson.integration: GitHub/GitLab + CI/CD + staging/production + monitoring/API access required
omerson.recommendation: This is substantially more complex than checking whether a deployment pipeline is green. The system needs actual post-deployment validation and rollback/escalation logic.

omerson.request: Clubwealth Explained — automate or create a UI instead of using a spreadsheet
omerson.automation: Build a Club Wealth Explained Knowledge Hub where users search or ask questions and receive answers from approved Club Wealth information instead of manually searching a spreadsheet.
omerson.integration: No app required for initial prototype. Knowledge base/database + AI integration required for production.
omerson.recommendation: This is one of the best opportunities to build early. Start by turning the spreadsheet into a structured knowledge source, then add AI search/Q&A.

omerson.automation: Build a Big Event Stat Tracker modeled after the existing Half Day stats system, with a dashboard for registrations, attendance, conversions, or other agreed event metrics.
omerson.recommendation: Good candidate because there is already a Half Day implementation to use as a reference. First map exactly which stats need to be collected.

omerson.request: BSM2026 digital registration similar to LABC2026
omerson.automation: Replicate/adapt the existing LABC 2026 digital registration workflow for BSM2026.
omerson.integration: Existing LABC system + registration/event platform integration required
omerson.recommendation: Since there is an existing implementation to model, this is considerably easier than creating a registration system from scratch.

omerson.request: AI writes the fixes / reviews and tests backend fixes
omerson.automation: Build an AI Coding & Repair Workflow where Claude analyzes bugs, proposes fixes, writes code, runs tests, reviews the changes, and prepares a pull request for human approval.
omerson.integration: GitHub + Claude Code + development/testing environment required
omerson.recommendation: AI coding is already useful here, but fully autonomous production changes should not happen without code review, automated tests, and approval gates.

omerson.request: Answer “why can’t this person see this?”
omerson.automation: Build an Access Troubleshooting Assistant that checks approved tags, rulesets, permissions, course/call/data access, and explains the likely reason a user cannot access something.
omerson.integration: Keap + Club Wealth University + permissions/access systems required
omerson.recommendation: Very strong AI use case if the AI can securely read the relevant configurations. Start read-only and have it provide the diagnosis before allowing any fixes.

omerson.request: Keap is my biggest time sink — give it to AI
omerson.automation: Build a Keap Operations Assistant for tag audits, ruleset checks, contact merges, and bulk tagging using documented business rules.
omerson.integration: Keap API/integration required; n8n/MCP could be useful
omerson.recommendation: High potential for time savings, but bulk changes and contact merges can affect many records. Start with audits/recommendations, then introduce controlled write actions.

omerson.automation: Build a Workflow Outcome Monitoring System that verifies whether an expected result actually happened instead of trusting a “success” status.
omerson.recommendation: This is one of the most technically difficult requests because the system needs to understand expected outcomes and detect silent failures across different applications.

jizel.request: Draft and rewrite client emails and messages
jizel.automation: Add a Client Communication Generator in the AI Task Hub. Jizel enters her notes/context, selects the type of message, and AI creates a clear response while preserving her preferred tone.
jizel.integration: No app required — AI Task Hub + Claude API
jizel.recommendation: One of the easiest tasks to build first. No external system is required for the initial version.

jizel.automation: Create a Billing Response Assistant where AI explains billing information, payment plans, discounts, balances, cancellation timelines, etc. based on verified client data.
jizel.integration: App / CRM / Billing system integration required
jizel.recommendation: AI should not guess billing information. It needs access to the actual source of truth before generating an explanation. Human review should remain required.

jizel.automation: Create a Coaching Follow-Up Assistant. Jizel selects the situation (assign coach, reschedule, confirm session, remind client, etc.), provides the relevant details, and AI generates the message.
jizel.integration: No app required for drafting. CRM/Calendar integration required for automatic scheduling/updates.
jizel.recommendation: Build the drafting portion first, then add automated scheduling and CRM updates later.

jizel.automation: Create an Event Communication Generator. Jizel enters/selects the event and AI generates registration emails, location information, hotel details, reminders, and helpful links using a standardized event brief.
jizel.integration: No app required initially. Event database/CRM integration recommended later.
jizel.recommendation: A good early AI Task Hub feature. Keep event information in one controlled source so AI uses the correct details.

jizel.request: Summarize client situations and account history
jizel.automation: Create a Client Summary Assistant that takes client notes/conversations and produces a structured summary: Situation → History → Current Issue → Important Details → Next Action.
jizel.integration: CRM integration required for automatic pulling of client history. No app required for manual input/upload version.
jizel.recommendation: Very useful for reducing time spent reading long conversations. Start with copy/paste/upload, then connect the CRM.

jizel.request: Create follow-up reminders and action lists
jizel.automation: Build a Follow-Up & Action Manager that identifies who needs a response, billing action, scheduling update, or follow-up and organizes them by priority/date.
jizel.integration: CRM + task/calendar integration required for automatic reminders.
jizel.recommendation: This becomes much more useful when connected to the actual task/client system instead of relying on manual input.

jizel.request: Help manage repetitive Client Care responses
jizel.automation: Build a Client Care Knowledge Assistant containing approved answers for Zoom, coaching, University, onboarding, billing, help desk, etc. AI finds the relevant answer and personalizes it.
jizel.integration: Knowledge base / document repository required. CRM integration optional.
jizel.recommendation: One of the strongest projects for Jizel. Build an approved knowledge base first so answers stay consistent.

jizel.request: Organize information from different tasks into trackers
jizel.automation: Create an AI Data Organizer that turns scattered notes/data into standardized tables and pushes them into predefined trackers.
jizel.recommendation: Useful for eliminating manual copy/paste. Need to identify exactly which information goes into which tracker.

jizel.request: Create internal team updates and summaries
jizel.automation: Create an Internal Update Generator where Jizel enters rough notes and AI turns them into concise updates for coaches, managers, or admin.
jizel.integration: No app required for drafting. Slack/Email/Teams integration optional for automatic delivery.
jizel.recommendation: Very easy to implement and a good early-win task.

jizel.request: Help with content and communication ideas
jizel.automation: Create a Content & Communication Assistant for motivational messages, huddle content, announcements, captions, and quick communications.
jizel.recommendation: Pure AI generation. Can be one of the first tools inside her AI Task Hub section.

jowee.automation: Build a Client Follow-Up Assistant inside the AI Task Hub. Jowelyn provides/selects the client and relevant context, and AI reviews the situation, previous conversation, and next step to create a personalized follow-up message.
jowee.integration: No app required for the first version. CRM integration required for automatic client history lookup and follow-up tracking.
jowee.recommendation: Build the message-generation version first. Later, connect the CRM so AI can automatically pull the client's history and identify who needs follow-up.

jowee.automation: Create a Call Script Generator where Jowelyn enters the client's concern and AI creates a natural, conversational script with key points, possible responses, and next steps.
jowee.recommendation: Excellent first AI Task Hub feature because it can work entirely from user-provided information.

jowee.automation: Create an Email Response Assistant. Jowelyn pastes the client's question or her notes, chooses the desired tone, and AI prepares a professional response.
jowee.integration: No app required initially. Email integration optional later.
jowee.recommendation: Very easy to implement and should be one of the first tools deployed.

jowee.automation: Build a Call Summary Assistant that turns a transcript into a structured output: Key Issue → Discussion → Action Items → Next Steps → Important Details.
jowee.integration: No app required for transcript upload/paste. Call/transcription integration required for automatic transcript retrieval.
jowee.recommendation: Start with transcript upload/paste, then connect the actual call/transcription system once identified.

jowee.automation: Create a Client Task Manager that takes client requests and organizes them by priority, deadline, owner, status, and next action.
jowee.integration: Task management / CRM integration required for persistent tracking and automatic updates.
jowee.recommendation: The AI organization is easy; the difficult part is keeping the task list synchronized with the actual system the team uses.

jowee.automation: Build an Event Follow-Up Assistant that identifies requirements such as tickets, registration, headshots, forms, payments, etc., and generates the appropriate reminder.
jowee.integration: Event/CRM system integration required for automatic status checking and reminders.
jowee.recommendation: Good candidate for automation after the event data source is identified. Start with AI-generated reminders before adding automatic tracking.

jowee.automation: Create an Internal Update Generator where Jowelyn enters rough notes and AI turns them into a short, clear update with What Happened → Current Status → What Needs to Happen → Who Needs to Act.
jowee.integration: No app required for generation. Slack/Email/Teams integration optional for automated delivery.
jowee.recommendation: Quick win with minimal technical complexity.

jowee.automation: Build an SOP Generator that takes a process description, notes, or transcript and converts it into a standardized SOP with steps, responsibilities, exceptions, and troubleshooting.
jowee.integration: No app required for first version. Knowledge/document repository integration optional later.
jowee.recommendation: Very suitable for the AI Task Hub and also useful for documenting the systems you build later.

jowee.automation: Create a Client Troubleshooting Assistant that takes the client's issue and produces possible causes, questions to ask, troubleshooting steps, and escalation criteria.
jowee.integration: Knowledge base / internal documentation required for reliable answers.
jowee.recommendation: AI should be grounded in Club Wealth's actual procedures and approved solutions rather than relying only on general AI knowledge.

jowee.automation: Build a Daily Work Planner where Jowelyn inputs her tasks and AI organizes them by urgency, deadline, priority, repetitive work, and automation opportunities.
jowee.integration: No app required for manual task input. Task/calendar integration recommended for a fully automated version.
jowee.recommendation: Very easy as a standalone assistant; becomes much more powerful once connected to her actual task/calendar systems.

kathleen.automation: Create a Blog Review Assistant that takes a draft and checks grammar, clarity, formatting, SEO opportunities, missing information, and overall readability.
kathleen.integration: No app required for first version.
kathleen.recommendation: This is one of the easiest tasks. It can run directly through the AI Task Hub with a text box or document upload.

kathleen.automation: Build a Campaign Builder where the user enters the campaign objective, audience, offer, and timing. AI creates the email sequence, subject lines, CTAs, and follow-up messages.
kathleen.integration: No app required for drafting. Email/CRM platform integration required for scheduling and launching campaigns.
kathleen.recommendation: Start as a campaign-generation tool, then connect it to the actual email system after the process is confirmed.

kathleen.automation: Create an Event Follow-Up Assistant that reviews form submissions, finds missing information, summarizes registrations, and generates follow-up tasks/messages.
kathleen.integration: Form system + CRM/event system integration required for automatic processing.
kathleen.recommendation: Very practical, but the form and event systems need to be identified first.

kathleen.automation: Build an Activity Audit Assistant that compares required actions against actual records and produces a report showing completed, missing, or overdue actions.
kathleen.recommendation: The AI analysis is straightforward; the main work is getting reliable records into the system and defining the audit rules.

kathleen.automation: Create a Task Assignment Assistant that checks task information against predefined assignment rules and recommends the correct RM. It can then prepare the ownership update.
kathleen.recommendation: Start with AI recommendations + human approval. Automatic reassignment can come later once the rules are confirmed.

kathleen.automation: Build an IFS Task Assistant that retrieves tasks, summarizes them, groups/prioritizes them, flags urgent items, and prepares follow-up actions.
kathleen.recommendation: Strong candidate for automation, but we need to understand exactly what data and actions IFS exposes.

kathleen.automation: Build a Speaker Coordination Tracker that tracks agreements, PPTs, headshots, missing materials, deadlines, and follow-ups, then generates reminders automatically.
kathleen.recommendation: Good automation candidate because the workflow is largely tracking + communication.

kathleen.automation: Create a Vendor Research Assistant that researches coffee carts, bands, and other vendors, extracts pricing/packages, organizes quotes in a comparison table, and summarizes the best options.
kathleen.integration: Web research capability required + optional Google Sheets integration
kathleen.recommendation: The research and summarization are manageable, but reliable web data collection and quote comparison make it more involved.

kathleen.automation: Build a Facebook Request Review Assistant that collects participant requests, checks them against Club Wealth criteria, organizes them by group, and flags exceptions for review.
kathleen.recommendation: Requires access to Facebook group/request information and dependable rules for qualification. Human review should remain for unclear cases.

kathleen.automation: Build a Referral Monitoring System that monitors approved Facebook groups, finds relevant posts, checks them against referral criteria, captures the lead information, and creates follow-up tasks.
kathleen.recommendation: Monitoring 30+ groups and reliably filtering relevant posts is much more complex than simply asking AI to analyze a post.

andrea.request: Turn event concepts into marketing campaigns
andrea.automation: Create an Event Campaign Generator. Andrea enters the event topic, speaker information, date, and audience, and AI produces registration-page copy, emails, reminders, social posts, text messages, talking points, sponsor messaging, and follow-up content.
andrea.integration: No app required for initial version. GHL/CRM + email/SMS integrations for automatic deployment.
andrea.recommendation: One of the best starting points because most of the work is content generation.

andrea.automation: Create a Conversation → Action Assistant that processes meeting notes, emails, and transcripts and extracts decisions, commitments, follow-ups, deadlines, owners, and next steps.
andrea.integration: No app required for upload/paste version. Email/transcription + task/CRM integration for automation.
andrea.recommendation: Strong quick win. Start with manual input, then automate data collection and task creation.

andrea.request: Build a reusable Club Wealth operating system
andrea.automation: Create an Event Operations Knowledge Hub that turns processes into SOPs, templates, checklists, research prompts, email sequences, and decision frameworks.
andrea.integration: No app required initially. Knowledge base / document repository integration recommended later.
andrea.recommendation: High value because the output can become the foundation for many other AI tools.

andrea.request: Create the entire event plan from one request
andrea.automation: Build an Event Planner where Andrea provides city, date, target attendance, event type, and goals. AI generates venue requirements, timeline, outreach plan, registration strategy, marketing calendar, follow-up schedule, staffing, and day-of checklist.
andrea.integration: No app required for planning. Calendar/CRM/event system integration for execution.
andrea.recommendation: Planning is very achievable; the harder part is connecting the generated plan to real event operations.

andrea.request: Analyze event performance and tell me what needs attention
andrea.automation: Create an Event Performance Analyzer that takes registration, attendance, outreach, engagement, and follow-up data and produces performance insights and recommended actions.
andrea.integration: Google Sheets/Excel or CRM integration required
andrea.recommendation: Very useful once the data is standardized. Start with uploaded/exported reports before building live integrations.

andrea.automation: Create a Partnership Research Assistant that researches associations, MLSs, brokerages, title/escrow companies, lenders, attorneys, etc., and outputs a structured partner database with contacts and opportunities.
andrea.integration: Web research required + optional Google Sheets/CRM integration
andrea.recommendation: The AI organization is easy; accurate research and contact discovery are the challenging parts.

andrea.request: Research an entire market before launching an event
andrea.automation: Create a Market Research Assistant that analyzes target markets, associations, brokerages, agent concentration, competing events, sponsors/hosts, and produces an event strategy.
andrea.integration: Web research required + optional research database/Sheets
andrea.recommendation: Good candidate for AI-assisted research, but results need verification before being used for business decisions.

andrea.automation: Build an Event Problem Solver. Andrea enters a situation such as venue cancellation or capacity issue, and AI researches replacement options, compares them, drafts communications, and creates a revised action plan.
andrea.recommendation: Requires AI to react to changing conditions, gather fresh information, and coordinate several downstream actions.

andrea.automation: Build an Outreach Automation System that segments contacts, generates personalized messages, tracks replies/registrations/declines/no-response, and triggers appropriate follow-ups.
andrea.integration: CRM + Email/SMS platform required; likely n8n/Make
andrea.recommendation: This is no longer just AI writing. It requires persistent contact state, triggers, timing logic, and multi-step automation.

andrea.request: Find and qualify event venues from start to finish
andrea.automation: Build a Venue Research & Qualification System that discovers potential hosts, verifies outside-event policies, compares capacity/location/cost/parking/AV/catering/contact details, and produces a prioritized outreach list.
andrea.integration: Web research required + database/Sheets/CRM; potentially email automation
andrea.recommendation: This combines research, qualification, data extraction, comparison, contact discovery, and prioritization into one workflow.

liz.request: Research REALTOR® associations in each target city and identify meeting rooms available for outside events
liz.automation: Build a Venue Research Assistant that takes a target city and event requirements, researches qualifying associations, and produces a structured list of potential venues.
liz.recommendation: The AI can organize research, but reliable venue discovery and verification will require web access and clear qualification criteria.

liz.request: Find the right contact person and gather email, phone, and rental information
liz.automation: Add a Venue Contact Finder that collects the facility/events/rental contact and organizes contact details and venue information into a standard record.
liz.recommendation: Contact discovery is more difficult than normal AI research because the system needs to identify the correct person rather than just any contact.

liz.request: Automatically send customized venue inquiry emails
liz.automation: Create a Venue Inquiry Generator that takes the event requirements and automatically fills the Club Wealth template with date, city, attendance, room setup, AV, parking, and other requirements.
liz.recommendation: Very good automation target. Start with AI drafting + human approval, then move to automatic sending once the workflow is proven.

liz.request: Automatically follow up with venues at 1 week, 4 days, 2 days, and 24 hours
liz.automation: Build a Venue Follow-Up Engine that records when the inquiry was sent, checks whether a reply was received, and triggers the correct follow-up based on the timeline.
liz.integration: Email + task/calendar/CRM integration required; n8n recommended
liz.recommendation: This requires persistent tracking and timed conditional logic. It is much more than simply generating an email.

liz.request: Track and organize venue responses in one place
liz.automation: Create a Venue Database / Tracker that stores rental cost, capacity, AV, parking, coffee, availability, restrictions, contracts, and payment requirements. AI can extract these details from incoming replies and quotes.
liz.integration: Google Sheets / database + Email integration required
liz.recommendation: Strong automation opportunity. The key is creating a standardized venue record so every response is stored in the same structure.

liz.automation: Build a Venue Fallback Research Workflow that follows a predefined sequence: REALTOR® associations → homebuilders associations → title companies → hotels.
liz.recommendation: The sequential logic is manageable, but the actual research and qualification across different organization types makes it more complex.

liz.request: Automatically compare venue options based on requirements
liz.automation: Create a Venue Comparison Assistant that scores each venue against capacity, price, parking, AV, location, setup, and availability and highlights the strongest options.
liz.integration: Venue database / Google Sheets integration required
liz.recommendation: Once venue data is standardized, this becomes much easier. AI can generate the comparison and recommendation from structured data.

liz.request: Calculate and compare total venue costs
liz.automation: Build a Venue Cost Calculator that breaks down rental, AV, coffee, taxes, and other fees and calculates the real estimated total for each venue.
liz.recommendation: The calculations themselves are straightforward. The harder part is reliably extracting all fees from different quotes.

liz.request: Create a complete venue proposal/update for Tara
liz.automation: Create a Venue Recommendation Generator that turns the collected venue data into a standardized update with recommendations, pricing, pros/cons, parking, AV, capacity, and outstanding approvals.
liz.integration: No app required for first version. Venue database integration recommended later.
liz.recommendation: Excellent AI Task Hub feature once venue data is organized.

liz.request: Build the event venue checklist and timeline automatically after a venue is selected
liz.automation: Create a Venue Closing Checklist Generator that uses the selected venue/event date to automatically generate tasks for agreement, payment, AV, room setup, parking, registration table, signage, and final confirmation.
liz.integration: No app required initially. Task/Calendar integration required for automatic task creation and reminders.
liz.recommendation: Very practical and easy to standardize. Full automation comes once the checklist can create and track tasks in the team's actual system.
